assessment_summary: I validated the manual (Option 2) installation described in the guide. I confirmed prerequisites (Node 24.15.0, pnpm 11.2.2 matching engines), the three backing Docker services (PostGIS on 5432, two Valkey instances on 6379/6380 with the required allkeys-lru vs noeviction policies), and full database state: all 7 Prisma migrations applied, schema up to date, PostGIS extension installed, audit triggers created, and seed data present (8 users, tenants, members). The .env file contains real generated secrets rather than defaults. Codegen artifacts and the Prisma client exist, and web-ifc wasm assets are served. Most importantly, I verified runtime behavior rather than file existence: the dev server is running and listening on port 3000, the app shell and Vite-transformed frontend entry are served with HTTP 200 on /, /map and /login, the GraphQL endpoint responds, and authentication works end-to-end (login with the seeded dev user returns a session cookie, current-user and authenticated GraphQL queries return the correct records, and wrong/unauthenticated requests are rejected). The only checks I could not complete were visual rendering of the 3D map (no browser binaries installed) and the production build path (not part of the documented dev path); neither indicates an incomplete installation. Based on the converging evidence, the software is installed correctly and operational.
